_comment: Zipcode config for the 30x46 BLOCK grid (each block = 4x4 spots on the 118x182 array).
bar_1 = X_code(14nt) + Y_code(14nt) = 28nt total, no spacer.
X encodes the 46-block column axis; Y encodes the 30-block row axis.
28 bits per axis gives generous Hamming headroom for the spatial gradient.
Adjacent blocks target distance = 4; far blocks (>=5 steps) target distance >= 16.
Physical note: 1 block step = 4 spot steps, so block-level distances are naturally higher.
